boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Franklin and Marshall College
boards.description: Ten under-21 food and convenience stops with directly verified late hours, ranging from two on-campus counters to Lancaster drive-throughs and all-night stores.

cards.title: Build a Bowl Before 11:30
cards.subtitle: A Friday-or-Saturday stop inside Steinman College Center
cards.notes: Go before the posted 11:30 p.m. Friday or Saturday close; summer and academic-break schedules can replace regular hours.
cards.short_summary: The campus option for customizable bowls and sushi on regular late-week evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M Dining lists Mein Bowl at 628 College Avenue and posts regular closing times of 11:30 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Mein Bowl- Steinman College Center | Franklin and Marshall College
cards.access_notes: Regular hours end at 11:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday, but the official page displays closures and special schedules during breaks; verify the date before leaving.

cards.title: Catch the Grill’s Late Window
cards.subtitle: An on-campus counter open later on Fridays and Saturdays
cards.notes: Use the official weekly-hours page before heading to Steinman; regular Friday and Saturday service extends to 11:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A second Steinman counter with a documented weekend-night schedule during regular operations.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M Dining’s current hours page lists regular hours for The Grill Off the Green through 11:30 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation | Franklin and Marshall College
cards.access_notes: Regular Friday and Saturday hours end at 11:30 p.m.; special summer and break closures supersede that schedule, so check the dated official listing first.

cards.title: Take Harrisburg Pike to Rosa Rosa
cards.subtitle: Brick-oven pizza close to the F&M side of Lancaster
cards.notes: Plan this for Friday or Saturday, when the restaurant posts a midnight close; Sunday runs end earlier at 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A nearby pizzeria whose own site documents a weekend midnight closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Rosa Rosa’s official site lists its address as 1040 Harrisburg Pike and hours until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Friday and Saturday; posted hours are 9 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 11 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Head Downtown for a 1 A.M. Pizza Counter
cards.subtitle: The 308 South Queen Street Dominion location
cards.notes: Choose the South Queen Street shop and order before its posted 1 a.m. Monday–Saturday close; Sunday service ends at midnight.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza, sub, and takeout option with late hours six nights each week.
cards.evidence_claim: Dominion Pizza’s official site identifies its South Queen Street location at 308 S Queen Street and lists business hours until 1 a.m. Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Monday–Saturday and noon–midnight Sunday; confirm that dine-in, takeout, or delivery fits your plan.

cards.title: Make a 24-Hour Convenience Run
cards.subtitle: An all-night Sunoco north of campus
cards.notes: Use this for packaged snacks or basic convenience items after restaurant kitchens close; the official station page lists 24-hour access.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock fallback with an official location page and street address.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunoco’s official page identifies station 0364000005 at 1204 Lititz Pike, Lancaster, and lists it as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Gas Station #0364000005 in Lancaster, PA | Sunoco
cards.access_notes: The official station page lists 24-hour operation every day; availability of individual store items can vary overnight.

cards.title: Use the 24/7 Old Philadelphia Pike Stop
cards.subtitle: An all-night convenience destination east of downtown
cards.notes: Save this driving option for hours when closer counters are shut; its official page confirms continuous access and mobile checkout.
cards.short_summary: A clearly identified 24/7 store for snacks, drinks, and convenience purchases.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven’s official store page lists 1954 Old Philadelphia Pike, Lancaster, and marks the location open 24/7.
cards.source_title: 1954 Old Philadelphia Pke in Lancaster, PA | 7-Eleven
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 according to the official location page; this destination is farther from campus and is most practical by vehicle.

cards.title: Use the 4 A.M. Columbia Avenue Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: Lancaster’s latest officially posted fast-food window
cards.notes: Travel by car and use the drive-through, whose official schedule runs to 4 a.m. daily; verify ordering access before departure.
cards.short_summary: A vehicle-oriented late run with a directly documented 4 a.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page for 1340 Columbia Avenue lists drive-through hours from 9 a.m. to 4 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Lancaster, PA — 1340 Columbia Ave
cards.access_notes: Drive-through hours are posted through 4 a.m. daily. Late access is vehicle-oriented; confirm dine-in status separately.

cards.title: Take the Weekend Lincoln Highway Run
cards.subtitle: A second late drive-through with Friday and Saturday extensions
cards.notes: Target Friday or Saturday for the posted 1 a.m. close; on other nights this drive-through closes at midnight.
cards.short_summary: An east-side fast-food option whose weekend hours run one hour past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-through service at 2040 Lincoln Highway East until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday and midnight otherwise.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Lancaster, PA — 2040 Lincoln Hwy East
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday and midnight Sunday–Thursday; posted dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Use the King Street Drive-Through Until 2
cards.subtitle: A downtown drive-through with later access than its lobby
cards.notes: Do not rely on the lobby after 11 p.m.; the official page separates lobby hours from the drive-through’s 2 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A central Lancaster run where late-night availability belongs specifically to the drive-through.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official page for 210 W King Street lists drive-through hours until 2 a.m. daily, while restaurant and lobby hours end at 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Lancaster, PA at 210 W King St | McDonald’s
cards.access_notes: Drive-through service is posted until 2 a.m. daily; the lobby closes at 11 p.m., so late access requires a vehicle.

cards.title: Use the Resort’s All-Night Sundries Shop
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour shop inside Wyndham Lancaster Resort
cards.notes: Enter through the resort and ask staff to direct you to the sundries shop; its dining page lists the shop as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A hotel-based fallback for purchasable sundries when conventional food counters are closed.
cards.evidence_claim: Wyndham Lancaster Resort’s official dining page lists its Sundries Shop as open 24 hours at 2300 Lincoln Highway East.
cards.source_title: Lancaster PA Dining | Wyndham Lancaster Resort & Convention Center
cards.access_notes: The Sundries Shop is listed as open 24 hours. It is inside a resort; ask the front desk about shop access and current inventory.
